_meta.source: CTOC14_problem.pdf (第十四届全国空间轨道设计竞赛 题目甲, 10 pages) — authoritative; this file is a machine-readable transcription plus verification notes
_meta.problem_title_zh: 近地小行星防御多航天器遍历探测轨道设计与优化
_meta.setter: 太空系统运行与控制全国重点实验室 (State Key Laboratory of Space System Operation and Control)
_meta.verification: All constants re-read from the PDF text (pdftotext). The Section 6.2 example lines were reproduced numerically: Earth position at t=0 to 0.5 m, launch v_inf = 4.000000 km/s, two-body coast line1->line2 to 3 m, asteroid 174 distance at the Event=3 time = 9 m, thrust-arc mass column reproduced to 2e-10 kg with the centred 0-based Lagrange window (see thrust_interpolation.confirmed_reading).

dt_sample_min.note: 0.1 day; minimum spacing of adjacent Event=1 lines inside one thrust arc (Event=3 lines in between are ignored)

t0_mission_start.note: Time column = seconds since t0; t=0 is a legal launch time (used in the PDF example)

epochs.note: M(t) = M0 + n*(t - t_eph) with t - t_eph in SECONDS (MJD difference * 86400); n = sqrt(mu_sun / (a*AU)^3) in rad/s; M0 in degrees must be converted.

dynamics.equation: r'' = -mu_sun r / |r|^3 + (T/m) u ; m' = -T/(Isp g0) ; T = |T_vec(t)| with T_vec the interpolated thrust (m' = -|T_vec(t)|/(Isp g0))
dynamics.unit_caution: T/m is in m/s^2 (N/kg); divide by 1000 to get km/s^2 when the state is in km. Verified against the PDF example.
dynamics.thrust_bounds: 0 <= |T| <= 0.5 N at ALL times (including between samples); u unit vector when T>0
dynamics.perturbations: none (pure two-body, Sun only); no planetary/asteroid gravity; gravity assists forbidden and not modelled
dynamics.earth_return: not required; a spacecraft ends its mission with an Event=4 line anywhere

verified_state_at_t0.note: position matches PDF example line 1 to 0.5 m; example launch velocity differs from v_earth by exactly 4.000000 km/s

launch.v_inf: |v_sc(t_launch) - v_earth(t_launch)| <= 4 km/s, any direction; validator tolerance 0.01 km/s
launch.line: Event=0 line: thrust columns (0,0,0), Asteroid_ID 0, mass column = m0_i (used in the cost)

mass.consistency: mass on each line must equal the integrated mass from the previous line within 0.01 kg

thrust.continuous: interpolated |T(t)| <= 0.5 N at every instant (validator checks throughout its integration); any exceedance = violation
thrust.other_lines: Event=0/2/3/4 lines must have thrust columns exactly (0,0,0)
thrust.spacing: adjacent Event=1 lines within an arc >= 8640 s apart (Event=3 lines in between ignored)

flyby.condition: |r_sc(t) - r_ast(t)| <= 1000 km at the Time of an Event=3 line whose Asteroid_ID names the asteroid (1..300)
flyby.declaration: ONLY Event=3 lines count; undeclared close approaches are ignored
flyby.repeats: only the first detection of each asteroid (over all spacecraft) counts; repeats are neither scored nor penalised, but every Event=3 line must itself satisfy d <= 1000 km

time_window.rule: ALL lines (Event 0,1,2,3,4) must have 0 <= Time <= 473364000 s (validator format check); flybys outside the window are not counted (Sec 5.1)
time_window.absolute: window is absolute (fixed calendar dates); late launch does not extend the end

misc: N >= 1 spacecraft, no stated upper bound on N

cost.per_spacecraft: J_i = 1 + x_i + x_i^2, x_i = (m0_i - 600)/1400 in [0,1]; m0_i read from the Event=0 line mass column
cost.total: J = sum_i J_i + N_miss, N_miss = 300 - N_covered

time_coefficient.k: k = 1 - 0.1 * (t_end - t_submit)/(t_end - t_start), k=0.9 at competition start, 1.0 at deadline
time_coefficient.multiple_submissions: k is computed from the time of the LAST valid submission; submissions after t_end are not scored
time_coefficient.t_start_t_end: announced on the competition website (not in the PDF)

derived_notes: empty spacecraft costs 1 = one missed asteroid, so a spacecraft must cover >= 2 asteroids to be strictly worthwhile
marginal fuel cost is tiny at low loads: ~0.011 cost units per km/s of dv (final mass 600 kg); the quadratic term only becomes significant for x > ~0.3 (m0 > ~1000 kg)
benchmark cost per asteroid: ballistic double = 0.5; x=0.5 spacecraft (30 km/s) covering 4 = 0.43; full tank covering 7 = 0.43

submission_file.comments: blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored
submission_file.ordering: sorted by SC_ID ascending, then Time strictly increasing within a spacecraft
submission_file.precision: double precision recommended; >= 10 significant digits recommended (%.10e or %.17g) — use %.17g

columns.name: Line
columns.desc: line number, positive integer (use global consecutive numbering)

columns.name: Event
columns.desc: 0 launch, 1 thrust sample, 2 coast node, 3 asteroid flyby, 4 mission end

columns.name: Tx Ty Tz
columns.desc: thrust vector; meaningful only on Event=1 lines; must be (0,0,0) on Event=0/2/3/4 lines (even for an Event=3 line inside a thrust arc)

columns.name: Asteroid_ID
columns.desc: asteroid id 1..300 on Event=3 lines, 0 otherwise

0.name: launch
0.rules: first line of each spacecraft; position = Earth (1 km), v_inf <= 4 km/s (0.01 km/s tol); mass = m0_i; thrust (0,0,0)

1.name: thrust sample
1.rules: a maximal run of consecutive Event=1 lines (Event=3 lines allowed inside) is one thrust arc; thrust vector at this instant; |T| <= 0.5; spacing >= 8640 s

2.name: coast node
2.rules: pure trajectory node with zero thrust; splits long integration segments; SEPARATES thrust arcs (an Event=2 between Event=1 lines ends one arc and starts another)

3.name: asteroid flyby
3.rules: records the state at the flyby time; Asteroid_ID 1..300; d <= 1000 km; does not change thrust state; if inside an arc the thrust at that instant is the arc interpolant; thrust columns still (0,0,0)

4.name: mission end
4.rules: last line of each spacecraft; thrust (0,0,0); Time <= mission_duration

submission_file.per_spacecraft_structure: Event=0, then any sequence of Event 1/2/3 lines with strictly increasing Time, then Event=4

thrust_interpolation.rule_text_zh: 设某推力弧有 n 个采样点，时刻 t1<...<tn，当 t∈[t1,tn] 时，推力的每个分量由采样值做 3 阶滑动窗口 Lagrange 插值确定——定位 t 所在区间 j (tj<=t<=tj+1)，窗口起点 l=j-1 并截断到 [0,n-4]，用窗口内 4 个采样点插值；当 n<4 时，改用全部 n 个采样点做 n-1 阶插值。当 t 在 [t1,tn] 之外时推力为零（即弧首、弧尾处推力瞬时开关）。飞越行时刻的推力同样按所在推力弧的插值确定。
thrust_interpolation.order: cubic (4 samples) for n >= 4; degree n-1 using all samples for n < 4 (n=1 constant on a single instant, n=2 linear, n=3 quadratic)
thrust_interpolation.window: 0-based sample indices s[0..n-1]; interval j = largest index with s_t[j] <= t (clipped to 0..n-2); l = min(max(j-1, 0), n-4); window = samples l, l+1, l+2, l+3
thrust_interpolation.outside_arc: T(t) = 0 for t < t1 or t > tn; instantaneous switch on/off at the first/last sample
thrust_interpolation.mass_flow: m' = -|T_vec(t)|/(Isp g0) using the NORM OF THE INTERPOLATED VECTOR (not the interpolated norm)
thrust_interpolation.index_base_ambiguity: PDF text uses 1-based t_1..t_n but the clip range [0, n-4] is 0-based. Two readings: (A) 0-based j, window {j-1,j,j+1,j+2} = two samples each side of the interval (centred) with clipping at the ends; (B) 1-based j, window {j,j+1,j+2,j+3} (forward-biased). They coincide on the first interval and differ elsewhere.
thrust_interpolation.confirmed_reading: A (centred, 0-based). Evidence: reconstructing the PDF example arc (41 samples, dt=86400 s, |T_k| = 0.5 sin(pi k/40), direction rotating 9 deg/sample about +z at elevation 17.188734 deg, azimuth 40.107046 + 9k deg) and integrating line 4 -> line 5 reproduces the printed mass 1999.8273580 kg to 2e-10 kg and the position to 3 m with reading A; reading B gives a 1.5e-5 kg mass error and 57 m position error (both would still pass the tolerances, but only A matches the printed digits).

example_arc_reconstruction.direction: azimuth = 40.107046 deg + 9 deg * k (in ecliptic xy-plane, about +z), elevation = 17.188734 deg (constant)

validator_checks.check: blank/# lines ignored; SC_ID consecutive from 1; per SC first line Event=0 and last Event=4; Time strictly increasing within SC; adjacent Event=1 lines in an arc >= 8640 s apart; every line 0 <= Time <= 473364000 s

starting from EACH line's state, integrate eq (1) with the interpolated thrust to the next line's Time; compare with that line: |dr| <= 1 km, |dv| <= 1 m/s (0.001 km/s), |dm| <= 0.01 kg. Each segment is checked independently from the submitted state (no error accumulation).
Event=0 position within 1 km of Earth ephemeris; v_inf <= 4 km/s with 0.01 km/s tolerance
each Event=1 line |T| <= 0.5 N; interpolated |T(t)| checked throughout the integration, any instant > 0.5 N is a violation; Event=0/2/3/4 thrust columns must be (0,0,0)

for each Event=3 line: Asteroid_ID in 1..300, distance between the line's position and the Keplerian asteroid position at Time <= 1000 km; only first detection per asteroid counts; undeclared approaches ignored
m0_i <= 2000 kg (Event=0 mass column); m >= 600 kg at all times; line-to-line mass consistent with integration within 0.01 kg
N_covered = number of distinct asteroids detected with t <= T_max; N_miss = 300 - N_covered; J = sum(1 + x_i + x_i^2) + N_miss with m0_i from Event=0 lines; ranking by J_final = k*J ascending

tolerances.thrust_tolerance: none stated — treat 0.5 N as a hard bound with your own margin

pdf_example_lines.note: Section 6.2, spacecraft 1; usable as validator/propagator test vectors (verified in this repo to metre level)
pdf_example_lines.description: launch at t=0 with v_inf = 4.000 km/s -> 115.8 d coast -> flyby of asteroid 174 (relative speed 11.78 km/s) -> 10 s later a 41-sample thrust arc (dt = 86400 s, smooth ramp 0 -> 0.5 -> 0 N, direction rotating uniformly in inertial space) -> coast -> Event=4
